title: Host a game
subtitle: You will be the host, {{username}}. Others scan your code to join.

name_card.title: Name the game
name_card.description: Shown to anyone who scans your code.

target_card.title: Target score
target_card.description: 46 is the standard. Whoever crosses it first wins outright - no waiting for the round to finish, no equal-turns fairness rule.

rules_card.title: House rules
rules_card.description: Both off is the game exactly as specified.

cap_streak.label: Pass the turn after 3 in a row
cap_streak.description: Without this, a team that keeps answering correctly keeps the turn forever - which can mean one team plays the whole game while everyone watches.

floor_score.label: Never go below zero
floor_score.description: Kinder, but it makes the professor-level question a free bet, which is the whole tension gone.

notice: You need at least two teams with a player each before the game can start. Two people on one team is not a game.
